Ein altes Tablet an der Wand: Die Karte: An old tablet on the wall: the card returns by itself, turns slowly and dims at night.
Teil zwei: der Kiosk-Bereich, die Option: Part two: the kiosk section, the options that only exist in YAML, and everything for old, weak wall tablets.
Ganz unten im Editor steht „Wandtablet (: At the very bottom of the editor is “Wall tablet (kiosk)”. “Back to the start view after”, „Zurück zur Startansicht nach“: one, two, five or ten minutes without a touch.
Dann schließt die Karte den Raum und zei: Then the card closes the room and shows the start view again. In the morning the tablet no longer sits in last night's bathroom.
Mit „Kamerafahrt als Bildschirmschoner“: With “Camera turn as screensaver” the house then turns slowly until someone touches the tablet.
Ich tippe aufs Bad und lasse das Tablet: I tap the bathroom and leave the tablet alone for a minute.
Eine Minute ohne Berührung: Die Karte is: One minute without a touch: the card is back, and the camera turn is running.
Die „Nachtdimmung“ dunkelt die ganze Kar: Night dimming, „Nachtdimmung“, darkens the whole card: “By the sun”, as soon as the sun sets, or in a time range.
Für den Zeitraum trägst du Start und End: For the time range you enter the start and the end, for example from 10 pm to 6 am.
„Knopf zu einem Dashboard“ setzt oben re: “Button to a dashboard” puts a button at the top right that opens another view – your home dashboard, say.
Mit „Beschriftung des Knopfs“ steht dort: With “Label of the button” a word stands there. Without one it shows a small house.
Alles geht auch in YAML. In Home Assista: Everything also works in YAML. In Home Assistant you switch the card dialog to the code editor.
Jede Option aus dem Editor hat dort ihre: Every option from the editor has its line there. A few exist only here.
„room“ startet die Karte in einem Raum –: “room” starts the card in a room – a display for the kids' room. The idle return then leads back there too.
„start_view“ gibt der Karte eine eigene: “start_view” gives the card a start view of its own. The ready-made line is in the editor under settings, “Start view”.
„controls_side: right“ legt Etagenbilder: “controls_side: right” moves the floor pictures, the star, the search and the eye to the right – good when the card sits at the left edge.
„keep_view: true“ behält beim Etagenwech: “keep_view: true” keeps the camera when you switch floors. Only the height moves along.
Unter „buttons“ legst du eigene Knöpfe n: Under “buttons” you put buttons of your own into the star, just for this card: open a page, details, a service or a popup.
Und „idle_return“ oder „controls_hide_af: And “idle_return” or “controls_hide_after” take any number of seconds here, not just the values from the list.
NeonPlan läuft auch auf alten, schwachen: NeonPlan also runs on old, weak wall tablets. The most important part: no work while idle.
Die „Leistungsanzeige“ zeigt es: Steht a: The performance display, „Leistungsanzeige“, shows it: when nothing moves, the card draws not a single frame – “at rest, zero frames per second”.
Erst wenn sich etwas bewegt, zeichnet si: Only when something moves does it draw – and it says why. Here a lamp's colour effect is running.
Die Stufe „Tablet“ spart am meisten: kei: The Tablet level saves the most: no patterns, shadows, halos or particles, and animations at half the frame rate.
Dazu zeichnet sie mit der Pixeldichte ei: On top of that it draws with a pixel ratio of one instead of up to two. That's up to four times fewer pixels in every frame.
Auf Fire-Tablets und Geräten mit wenig S: On Fire tablets and on devices with little memory or at most four processor cores, Auto picks this level by itself.
Mein Tipp: Fully Kiosk Browser mit Hardw: My tip: Fully Kiosk Browser with hardware acceleration, the card in a panel view with “Fill the screen”, and leave the quality on Auto.
